compliance.title: Privacy & Compliance
compliance.subtitle: Symbio AI Academy is committed to student data protection and responsible AI use. We operate under strict privacy standards to keep learner data safe, anonymous, and never used for model training.

zeroDataTraining.title: Zero Data-Training API Sandboxing
zeroDataTraining.desc: All student data is processed within isolated sandboxed environments and never used to train external or internal models.

ferpa.title: FERPA School Official Alignment
ferpa.desc: Our platforms align with FERPA guidelines for educational records, ensuring compliance and lawful data stewardship.

deidentified.title: Automated De-Identification
deidentified.desc: We use automated proxy standards to de-identify student data, protecting identities while preserving valuable learning outcomes.
